title: Build AlphaVeil Home, Matches and Match Overview
objective: Turn the accepted AlphaVeil shell into a real-data Home, match library and allowlisted Match Overview experience without changing factual, review or playback semantics.
moduleGoal: Translate accepted workspace data into a legible player-facing match experience.
observableOutcome: A user can navigate Home to Matches to Overview to a friendly Review deep link and, where available, synchronized Replay.
metricContribution: Four real match summaries, deterministic covers, real review progress, safe material capability states and responsive browser flows.
remainingModuleGap: Workspace UX V2 and Replay UX V2 remain future separately authorized work.
hardeningDeferred: No factual pipeline, candidate ranking, synchronization, ASR, patterns, training or coaching work.

executionContract.reasoningComplexity: High: build a privacy-safe product view model and responsive real-data flows across accepted workspaces.
executionContract.objective: Deliver Home, Matches and allowlisted Match Overview from existing workspace state and media references.
technicalContext: Task 213 externally accepted at the exact base; public identity remains AlphaVeil and internal deadem identities remain unchanged.
branchEnvironment: Windows PowerShell, npm.cmd, main, exactly one normal pushed commit.
allowedScope: Product view model/API, Home, match library, allowlisted Overview, friendly Review links, presentation tests/canary and compact coordination artifacts.
protectedAreas: No replay 005-008, .dem, media versioning, factual regeneration, ASR, candidate/ranking/sync/player changes or Task215.
expectedChanges: Real-data presentation endpoints, cards, deterministic covers, derived progress/materials, responsive layouts and browser evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Four real matches, no fabricated metadata, real progress, safe covers, Overview 001-004, friendly deep links and replay CTA only for resolvable real sessions.
Task213/212 Review and Replay contracts remain intact.
mandatoryTests: Product view-model unit/HTTP tests, Task213 shell, Task212 integration, Review/Scrim regressions and isolated real browser flows.
requiredEvidence: Compact summary/gate, local screenshots at 1920x1080, 1440x900 and 390x844, report and structural post-commit attestation.
commitPolicy: Exactly one commit: Build AlphaVeil home and match experience; explicit staging; normal push main; no amend or force.
stopConditions: Base divergence, fabricated data, functional regression, protected access, media staging or unavailable match experience.
returnReportFormat: Resultado; O que passou a funcionar; Experiência visual; Product data integrity; Navegação; Browser canary; Regressão funcional; Segurança e privacidade; Limitações; Git; Gate; Próximo objetivo.

stopConditions: No Task215, media versioning, replay access, ASR, factual regeneration or deep Review/Replay redesign.
